# [Docs] Synchronize README and issue tracker documentation with resolved status

**Repository:** `AgroLock/agrolock`  
**Labels:** `documentation`, `maintenance`, `low`

---

## Description

With all 10+ major audit findings and feature tasks now implemented across the smart contract, backend API, and frontend dApp, the project documentation (`README.md` and `.github/issues/README.md`) must be synchronized to reflect the resolved status of all issues.

## Proposed Resolution

1. Update `README.md` to list resolved security and architectural enhancements.
2. Update `.github/issues/README.md` with complete links to all GitHub issues `#2` through `#38`.
